issues.text: Beyond the findings (AP-019), for ORCH: with F4 closed, criterion 3 of REQ-108 bans only the global fetch, while app/server may still import `node:http`, `node:https`, `node:http2`, `node:net`, `node:tls` and `node:dgram`, through which a request to an outside address is possible; Q11 then holds by construction only as long as nobody writes such a request. Proposal: add to the import rules «no `node:http`, `node:https`, `node:http2`, `node:net`, `node:tls`, `node:dgram` in app/server and app/api» (the Hono node server and pg import them inside node_modules, which the rule does not read). Not done here; named in the block as a limit. Default if not answered: the limit stays named.

Two edits follow from F2/F14 and decisions/0116 О18 rather than from a separate finding: the gate page is one file of app/public (so the build can leave it alone and `npm run check` has passed it through check-public), and that page joins the browser step of REQ-108 criterion 14 (the page shown in an emergency renders under the same checks).
AP-005: the references «question Оn» of step 01 (19 places) now read «decisions/0116 Оn», and both Bar lines say the choices are recorded in decisions/0116 (О1-О21); no meaning changed.

О17 names the unpooled URL for migrations (ARCH §19.6); compose and the pg job have one URL, so the block takes DATABASE_URL when DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED is unset (REQ-108 description and criterion 8). This fallback is not written in decisions/0116; the gate may confirm it.

Feasibility, not measured: Postgres takes no bind parameter in CREATE ROLE or ALTER ROLE, so «the password reaches the database only as a parameter» needs a server-side form, for example `select set_config('<name>', $1, true)` followed by a DO block that runs `format('ALTER ROLE sai_app_login PASSWORD %L', current_setting('<name>'))`; the design measures it on Postgres 17 (and on PGlite, decisions/0116 О10). Also not measured: whether the pg pool still holds a connection at the moment of the pg_stat_activity probe of REQ-108 criterion 12 (the design probes right after the request or keeps one open).

The outside-path check of REQ-108 criterion 11 removes paths with `rm` in a fresh clone outside the project; it uses no git checkout, reset, stash or clean (docs/workflows/handoffs.md, common rule 3).

Trial slips, each undone at once and written in self_check: a folder passed to `node --test` ran as one failing file (rerun by file path); the link pattern of the runbook sketch lacked the version; the first secret pattern missed a password of one `$`. All trial files lie in <scratch>/m1site-01/trial-01b/; nothing was written to the system temporary folder or into the project except docs/requirements.yaml (the two blocks) and this handoff; no Vercel command; network reads only the pages named in self_check.

Not measured, left as the blocks say: the Vercel command forms and the status of the static gate page (spike S1), the Neon role attributes (spike S3), PGlite's roles (decisions/0116 О10), the password-by-parameter form (I5).
